method.tiltDefinition: Angle between world-up and the rigid body local +Y axis. Sweep value is acos(1 - 2(x² + z²)) from the engine quaternion; an independent normalized quaternion-vector rotation computes the same angle per frame.
method.secondTiltDefinitionFinding: The Jolt ellipsoid/body-center function estimates a contact point from the line between body centers; it is not a tilt estimator and returns no tilt value. No second proxy-surface tilt is defined in the frozen harness.
method.colliderTiltDefinition: All five collision shapes are rigidly attached to one body, so each receives the same per-collider rigid-body peak tilt. Separately, perColliderLongAxisPeakTilt is each capsule long-axis inclination to world-up after child and body rotations; absolute axis dot handles the unoriented capsule axis. The spherical head has no orientation-defined long axis.

singleBodyProbe.geometry: same five-collider 96 kg player proxy and ground box as the sweep
singleBodyProbe.drop: upright body released from rest with center at y=3.0 m; 2 seconds simulated
singleBodyProbe.impulse: after 24 settle steps, apply horizontal +x impulse at world point [0, 1.445, 0] m; 2 seconds simulated
singleBodyProbe.magnitudeContext: 120–300 N·s brackets the 121.9–309.3 N·s Rapier sweep contact-impulse estimates; Jolt sweep values are carrier momentum-change estimates including support impulses, so this is a scale comparison, not an equal-contact-impulse replay.
